Yes
The workflow is workable, unambiguous, and fair to developer execution. Committing the multi-family corpus and encoding variants before the red phase provides concrete, deterministic inputs and boundary cases, eliminating ambiguity for the red and green developer seats. Separating red test authoring from green implementation prevents gaming and preserves test independence. Keeping per-slice unit verification and offline runs ahead of gated heavy runs respects slice limits and developer cadence under the heavy-run lock.
